max.description: Only match files newer than this duration. Min: 0s Max: 87600h

min.description: Only match files older than this duration. Min: 0s Max: 87600h

all.description: AND logic: file must match all sub-filters simultaneously.

any.description: OR logic: file must match at least one sub-filter.

match.description: Name-based filter: glob, regex, or literal match (pick one).

case-sensitive.description: Whether matching is case-sensitive. Applies to regex, glob, and literal.

glob.description: Glob pattern matched against the filename. Mutually exclusive with regex and literal. Format: glob

literal.description: Exact filename match (whole name must equal this string). Mutually exclusive with regex and glob.

regex.description: RE2 regular expression matched against the filename. Mutually exclusive with glob and literal. Format: regex

mime.description: Match by the file's real MIME type (magic bytes), as a glob against the detected type. Examples: "image/*", "application/pdf". Reads the file content; combine with extensions: [all] to match by real type.

not.description: NOT logic: exclude files matching any of these sub-filters.

max.description: Only match files no larger than this size. Min: 0B Max: 100TB

min.description: Only match files at least this large. KB/MB/GB/TB are decimal; KiB/MiB/GiB/TiB are binary. Min: 0B Max: 100TB

categories.description: List of file movement rules. Each entry defines a source directory, file filters, a destination, and optional hooks.

destination.description: Destination configuration: where to place matched files, how to name them, and what to do on conflicts.

action.description: File operation to perform. 'move' removes the source; 'copy' keeps it; 'symlink' links it; 'archive' packs the whole category into one compressed file (requires the archive block).

archive.description: Archiving options. Required when action is 'archive'. Packs all matched files of the category into one zip/tar.gz at the destination path.

flatten.description: Put every file at the archive root. Defaults to false, which preserves each file's sub-path relative to the source directory (relevant with recursive scans).

format.description: Archive container/compression: 'zip' (universal) or 'tar.gz'. Required — no default.

keep-source.description: Keep the original files after archiving. Defaults to true; set false to delete sources after a successful write.

name.description: Archive filename base (extension is added automatically). Supports category/date/system tokens only: {category}, {date}, {timestamp}, {hostname}, {username}, {os}. Empty uses the category name.

conflict-strategy.description: What to do when a file with the same name already exists at the destination.

organize-by.description: Token pattern used to build sub-directories inside the destination path. Leave empty to place all files directly. Format: organize-by pattern
examples:
organize-by: "{ext}/{year}"

# Available tokens:
# {ext}   file extension
# {year}  4-digit year
# {month} 2-digit month
# {day}   2-digit day

path.description: Directory where matched files are placed. Format: directory

rename.description: Token pattern for the destination filename. It becomes the whole filename, so include {ext} to keep the extension (omit it and the file is written without one). Leave empty to keep the original name. Format: rename pattern
examples:
rename: "{year}-{month}-{day}_{name}.{ext}"

# Full filename — include {ext} to keep the extension.
# {name}  filename without extension
# {year}, {month}, {day}, {hour}, {minute}, {second}
# {seq}   auto-incrementing counter
# {sha256:N}  first N hex chars of SHA-256

enabled.description: Whether this category is active. Must be explicitly set to true; omitting this field disables the category.

hooks.description: Optional shell commands to run before and after each file is moved.

after.description: Hook executed after the file operation completes successfully.

on-failure.description: What to do if a hook command exits non-zero: abort the file's operation, or warn and continue.

shell.description: Shell interpreter for hook commands. Defaults to $SHELL on Unix/macOS and cmd on Windows.

before.description: Hook executed before the file operation. If it fails, the move is aborted (unless on-failure is 'warn').

on-failure.description: What to do if a hook command exits non-zero: abort the file's operation, or warn and continue.

shell.description: Shell interpreter for hook commands. Defaults to $SHELL on Unix/macOS and cmd on Windows.

name.description: Human-readable identifier for this category. Used in logs, history, and the --category filter flag.

source.description: Source directory configuration: which path to watch, which extensions to include, and how deep to scan.

exclude-paths.description: Absolute paths to skip during recursive walk. The destination path is always auto-excluded.

extensions.description: File extensions to match (without the leading dot). Use the special value "all" to match every file.
examples:
extensions:
  - jpg
  - jpeg
  - png

# or, to match every file:
extensions: [all]

filter.description: Optional filtering rules applied to each matched file. All populated sub-fields must match (AND logic) unless any/all are used.

max-depth.description: Maximum sub-directory depth when recursive is true. 0 means unlimited.

path.description: Directory to watch for incoming files. Format: directory

recursive.description: Whether to scan sub-directories of the source path. Combine with max-depth to limit depth.

configuration.description: General settings for movelooper, grouped into logging, watch, history, and defaults sub-sections.

defaults.description: Fallback destination settings applied to any category that omits them. Per-category values always win.

action.description: Fallback action for categories that omit destination.action.

conflict-strategy.description: Fallback conflict-strategy for categories that omit destination.conflict-strategy.

organize-by.description: Fallback organize-by template for categories that omit destination.organize-by.

history.description: Undo-history settings: whether tracking is on, how many batches to keep, and where to store them.

enabled.description: Whether move events are recorded for undo. Set to false to skip history tracking entirely.

file.description: Path to the history file used for undo. Defaults to ~/.movelooper/history/movelooper.json when not set. Format: directory

limit.description: Maximum number of move batches kept in the undo history. Older batches are evicted when the limit is reached.

logging.description: Log output settings: destination, severity level, format, file path, and caller info.

color.description: ANSI color for the pretty format. 'auto' colors the console but not files; 'always'/'never' force it on or off. Ignored when format is json.

file.description: Path to the log file. Only used when output is 'file' or 'both'. Supports ~ for the home directory. Format: directory

format.description: Log rendering format. 'pretty' is the human-readable console renderer; 'json' emits structured slog JSON lines for log aggregation.

level.description: Minimum severity level to emit. Lower levels produce more output; 'fatal' produces the least.

max-width.description: Maximum width, in columns, for wrapping pretty log lines. Ignored when format is json.

output.description: Where log output is written. Use 'both' to write to the console and a file simultaneously. 'log' is an alias for 'file'.

show-caller.description: Append the source file and line number to each log entry. Useful when debugging hooks or scanners.

delay.description: How long a file must go without a new create/write event before it is considered stable and moved. Accepts Go duration strings (e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h). Min: 1s Max: 168h

poll-interval.description: How often watch mode re-checks pending files for stability. Keep it shorter than delay so stable files are picked up promptly. Min: 1s Max: 1h
